map.用法：纪念币按 NGC/Sheldon 70 分制，邮票按 PSE 100 分制: Usage: coins by NGC/Sheldon 70-point scale, stamps by PSE 100-point scale. For each of six flaws choose none / slight / moderate / severe; the deductions accumulate and are subtracted from the base (coin 70, stamp 100), with a lower bound of 1 point, then mapped to a grade. Coin deductions: obverse / reverse wear [0, 2, 6, 12], edge or rim damage [0, 1, 4, 10], luster or toning loss [0, 1, 4, 9], contact marks or scratches [0, 1, 3, 8], stains oxidation corrosion [0, 2, 5, 10]. Stamp deductions: perforations / gum condition / centering [0, 5, 12, 20], creases or cracks [0, 5, 12, 22], stains yellow spots mold [0, 5, 12, 18], color vividness [0, 5, 10, 18].
map.例：纪念币 正面轻微(2)+背面轻微(2)+边齿无(0)+原光中等(4)+划痕轻: Example: coin obverse slight (2) plus reverse slight (2) plus edge none (0) plus luster moderate (4) plus scratch slight (1) plus stain none (0) gives cumulative deduction 9, score 61, MS-60 to 64 uncirculated Mint State. If most of six are moderate gives cumulative deduction 22, score 48, XF-40 to 45 Extremely Fine. Stamp perforations slight plus centering slight plus stain slight (each 5) gives cumulative deduction 15, score 85, VF 80 to 89 sound; if several moderate gives cumulative deduction 51, score 49, Poor 30 to 49.
map.这个评分能代替专业评级吗？: Can this score replace professional grading?
map.不能。NGC/PCGS/PSE 的正式评级还包含清洗、修补、真伪鉴定与目检经验等: No. NGC/PCGS/PSE formal grading also includes cleaning, repair, authenticity and visual-experience subjective judgment; this tool only quantifies flaw deductions as an aid for self-grading and expectation management.
map.为什么单列「原光/包浆流失」一项？: Why list luster / toning loss separately?
map.原光是未流通币的重要特征，清洗或长期摩擦会破坏原光，即使无明显磨损也会大幅降分；: Luster is an important feature of uncirculated coins; cleaning or long friction destroys luster and drops the score significantly even without obvious wear; the stamp-side counterpart is gum condition, where original gum versus no gum has a large price gap.
map.本工具为辅助评估，采用瑕疵扣分模型，不能替代专业评级机构的实体鉴定: This tool is an aid using a flaw-deduction model and cannot replace the physical authentication of a professional grading agency
map.纪念币以 Sheldon 70 分制为基准（满分 70），邮票以 PSE 100: Coins use the Sheldon 70-point scale (max 70), stamps use the PSE 100-point scale (max 100)
map.建议在充足光源、放大镜下逐项观察后再选择瑕疵程度: Recommend observing each flaw under ample light and a magnifier before choosing severity
map.清洗、修补、改刻等处理会严重影响评级，本工具未单独计入，需人工判定: Cleaning, repair and alteration severely affect grading and are not separately counted here, needing manual judgment
